import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, capacity;

        public Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int capacity) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static int source, sink;
    static List<List<Integer>> G = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] ptr = new int[1001];
    static int[] dist = new int[1001];
    static String[] scientists = new String[101];
    static String[] reactors = new String[101];
    static boolean[][][][] isReachable = new boolean[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] visited = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] becomesUnusableAt = new int[10][10];
    static int n, m;
    static int INF = (int)1e9 + 9;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        G.get(u).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity));
        G.get(v).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static boolean isValid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }

    static int getID(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }

    static boolean findPath() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.offer(source);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = Q.poll();
            for (int id : G.get(u)) {
                int v = e.get(id).v;
                if (dist[v] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).capacity) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    Q.offer(v);
                    if (v == sink)
                        return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long sendFlow(int u, long flow) {
        if (flow == 0)
            return 0;
        if (u == sink)
            return flow;

        for (; ptr[u] < G.get(u).size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            int id = G.get(u).get(ptr[u]);
            int v = e.get(id).v;
            if (dist[v] != dist[u] + 1)
                continue;
            long pushed = sendFlow(v, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).capacity - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long dinics() {
        long flow = 0;
        while (findPath()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            for (long pushed; (pushed = sendFlow(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0; ) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        T++;
        n = sc.nextInt();

        m = n;
        int size = m * m * 2 + 2;
        G = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        // Read scientists
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            scientists[i] = sc.next();
        }

        // Initialize becomesUnusableAt
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String reactorRow = sc.next();
            reactors[i] = reactorRow;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = INF;
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    // Using a queue for BFS
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS to propagate becomesUnusableAt
        Queue<int[]> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    Q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = Q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int nx = x + dx[dir];
                int ny = y + dy[dir];
                if (isValid(nx, ny) && becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] == INF && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] = becomesUnusableAt[x][y] + 1;
                    Q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        int totalNodes = m * m * 2 + 2;
        source = 0;
        sink = totalNodes - 1;

        // Build graph
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                char sciChar = scientists[x].charAt(y);
                if (sciChar >= '1' && sciChar <= '9') {
                    addEdge(source, getID(x,y), sciChar - '0');
                }
                char resChar = reactors[x].charAt(y);
                if (resChar >= '1' && resChar <= '9') {
                    addEdge(n * n + getID(x, y), sink, resChar - '0');
                }
                for (int X = 0; X < n; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; Y++) {
                        if (scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' ||
                            reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
                            Arrays.fill(visited[i], 0);
                        }
                        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
                        q.offer(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        int[][] visitedCells = new int[n][m];
                        for (int[] row : visitedCells)
                            Arrays.fill(row, 0);
                        visitedCells[x][y] = 1;

                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] curr = q.poll();
                            int cx = curr[0], cy = curr[1], time = curr[2];

                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (time >= becomesUnusableAt[cx][cy] || time >= T)
                                continue;
                            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                                int nx = cx + dx[dir], ny = cy + dy[dir];
                                if (isValid(nx, ny) && visitedCells[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                                    scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' &&
                                    time + 1 <= becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny]) {
                                    visitedCells[nx][ny] = 1;
                                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, time + 1});
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (found) {
                            addEdge(getID(x, y), n * n + getID(X, Y), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = dinics();
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
